messages:
harper (Marketing): Heads-up team — aiming to publish the Orbit release post next Wed 09:00am PT. Need final changelog, a canonical docs URL (not a preview), and a short bench blurb (1 paragraph) + 3 bullets for slide copy by EOD Mon. Also need a staging webhook for webinar regs.
noah (Engineering): Working on the changelog (PR #11012). I'll include the canary schedule, rollback command, and a Dedicated migration snippet. Will paste config snippet for Ivy to copy.
noah (Engineering): Canary plan draft: 5% -> 25% at 20m -> 60% at 80m -> 100% at 3h if health checks pass. Rollback: `rictl rollback --release orbit --to previous`.
ivy (Docs): I can publish /docs/orbit-release once the PR merges. Please make sure example `orbit.yaml` is in the changelog PR so I can copy it verbatim; I need a stable URL for marketing.
tom (Product): Webinar locked for Thu 11am PT. Marketing wants a 25-35 word teaser for the registration, one 40-60 word bench paragraph for the landing, and 3 bullet highlights for slides (latency, cost, migration ease). Also confirm inbound mapping for leads (owner/campaign/source).
harper (Marketing): For the promo we'll use the 25-35 word line and bullets on the webinar page. We also need a single-sentence Dedicated callout for the post so Support can triage fewer tickets.
noah (Engineering): Bench paragraph draft: 'Orbit speeds up median decode by ~29% on long-context prompts and lowers per-token inference cost by ~31% thanks to adaptive batching and improved quant kernels. An optional session prefetch mode keeps p95 stable under sustained traffic.'
noah (Engineering): Bullets: 1) ~29% median latency improvement (8k), 2) ~31% per-token cost reduction with adaptive batching+quant, 3) optional session-prefetch for consistent p95 on hot sessions.
harper (Marketing): Great — can you trim the paragraph to ~40 words for the landing and provide a 25-word teaser for the webinar? Also include a one-line Dedicated note we can drop in the post.
noah (Engineering): Landing (40w): 'Orbit reduces median latency by ~29% and cuts per-token cost ~31% on long-context workloads via adaptive batching and quant-tuned kernels; optional session-prefetch stabilizes p95 under load.' Teaser (25w): 'Orbit: faster responses, lower inference cost — live demo + migration tips.' Dedicated note: 'Dedicated customers should enable session_prefetch in orbit.yaml; see migration snippet in docs.'
webhook-bot: Staging webhook created: https://hooks.staging.redwood/growth/orbit-reg — test key issued, expires in 7d. Mapping: lead.owner, lead.campaign, lead.source available.
ivy (Docs): I'll merge and publish canonical https://docs.redwood.com/release/orbit once changelog PR lands. ETA tomorrow AM.
tom (Product): For rollout language in the post, we'll mention the staggered canary and include the exact window and rollback command. Noah, paste the metrics to watch in the changelog so we can reference them.
noah (Engineering): Will add metric thresholds (error rate > 0.5% or latency p95 regression > 15% triggers rollback) and paste CLI.
harper (Marketing): Thanks — I'll lock the post draft tonight and slot the webinar promo for Wed AM. Once Ivy drops the canonical docs link and the webhook is validated, we'll schedule the publish. :rocket:
